title: N -W F P Public Service Commission Amendment Act 1975

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Public Service Commission Amendment Act 1975
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXXVI OF 1975
ACT XXXVI OF 1975
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An Act to amend
the North-West Frontier Province Public Service
Commission Act,
1973
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 12th April 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 8th April 1975, and is hereby
published for general information :-
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the North-West Frontier Province
Public Service Commission (Amendment) Act, 1975.;
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 16th August
1974.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Public Service Commission Amendment Act 1975
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3, N.W.F.P. Act No. XIX of 1973

ACT XXXVI OF 1975
ACT XXXVI OF 1975
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An Act to amend
the North-West Frontier Province Public Service
Commission Act,
1973
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 12th April 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 8th April 1975, and is hereby
published for general information :-
2. Amendment of section 3,
N.-W.F.P. Act No. XIX of 1973.--In the North-West Frontier Province Public
Service Commission Act, 1973 (N.-W.F.P. Act No. XIX of 1973), in section 3, for
subsection (2) the following shall be substituted, namely :-
"(2) The Commission shall
consist of such number of members not exceeding four, of whom one shall be the
Chairman, as may be appointed by the Governor, on such terms and conditions as
may be prescribed".
